car.name: Rampion 1987
car.description: Roberto Ravaglia, 1987 Nürburgring WTCC round BMW M3 E30 Group A inspiration, from his world-title season. Naturally aspirated 2.3L four, rear drive, original violet/cream race art. Competition references separated from estimated event setup.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: Roberto Ravaglia, BMW M3 E30 Group A at the 1987 Nürburgring WTCC fourth round, during his world-championship season. Not the road Ravaglia edition, later2.5L DTM, or a claim of victory at this event.
